purpose: Sanitized relationship reconciliation and source-attribution policy. Detailed third-party identifiers, raw messages, contact data, and uncertain identity evidence remain local/private.

partner.rule: Newest direct user wording controls the current relationship label; household evidence does not establish Olivia's individual preferences.

family.sibling_structure: User is the oldest of five siblings.
family.rule: Keep individual sibling identities and private family dynamics local unless a task explicitly requires them.

source_attribution_policy.profile_promotion_default: Direct personal-profile promotion requires both user/user_confirmed authorship and user/user_confirmed subject attribution, unless the user explicitly confirms the candidate.
source_attribution_policy.mixed_archive_rule: Organizational mail/PST archives must resolve message actor and subject before creating personal-profile candidates.
source_attribution_policy.same_name_rule: Name equality alone never merges people.
source_attribution_policy.subject_not_equal_actor: Authorship and subject identity are separate. A user-authored message about an applicant, coworker, family member, or organization is not autobiographical evidence.

quarantined_or_unresolved.reason: Conflicts with stronger/current biography and is plausibly attributable to another user of the shared ChatGPT account.
